cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth — lying on her left side; inside a general's command tent — kneeling on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — sitting on the ground; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light — standing
